rows.note: Use 鐵路 as the all-purpose noun for the railway system or rail transport.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tit3 lou6 heoi3 si5 keoi1 gaa3

rows.note: Use 鐵軌 for the physical metal rails that trains run on.

example.english: The workers are replacing a damaged rail.
example.traditional: 工人而家換緊一條壞咗嘅鐵軌。
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 ji4 gaa1 wun6 gan2 jat1 tiu4 waai6 zo2 ge3 tit3 gwai2

rows.note: Use 扶手 for the part of a rail that people hold for support, such as on stairs.

example.english: When taking the stairs, hold on tight to the rail or you'll slip.
example.traditional: 行樓梯嗰陣要捉實扶手，唔係會跣親。
example.jyutping: haang4 lau4 tai1 go2 zan6 jiu3 zuk3 sat6 fu4 sau2 m4 hai6 wui5 sin3 can1

rows.note: Use 欄杆 for a railing or barrier, especially one along a balcony, bridge, or roadside.

example.english: Be careful, don't lean against the rail.
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 kaau3 zyu6 laan4 gon1
